notes.title: 🎮「Astra Village」Development News #15
notes.content:
[h1][b]
[/b][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/eaf15b69dcf85bf184223b2be45fedccac420c4f.png"][/img][/h1][p]
[/p][p align="start"]Hello everyone! This is the [i]Astra Village[/i] development team. 👩‍🌾✨
Today, we’d like to show you some UI elements that have actually been implemented in the game.[/p][p][/p][quote][p]Please note that the language settings are not yet unified.
Also, as these are under development, the final release may differ from what is shown here. 
Thank you for your understanding.[/p][/quote][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Item Encyclopedia & Crafting Encyclopedia[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/eb10161eb6d30dea7effacd2733873fb47635649.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve added a feature that allows you to jump between the two encyclopedias by clicking on the item icons showing usage or materials.[/p][p][/p][p]This helps players understand recipes more easily and reduces the hassle of switching encyclopedias.
As crafting is an important part of the game, we’ve worked to make this system as user-friendly as possible.[/p][p][/p][p]  [/p][hr][/hr][h3]
✔ Map & Marker[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/a43f10abcf05b70f4eef090e46f6de5f12bd0bbc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]We’ve implemented a marker function on the map.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]By clicking on a location where you want to place a marker, a window will appear.[/p][p]You can write a memo, select a marker icon, and place the marker by pressing the save button.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]There is also a sort function in the bottom-right corner, allowing you to display only specific markers.[/p][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Calendar[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/c0d9cd4fbe721236fa3e987e4cdce0b5a0da8a3a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]The year consists of four seasons, and each week has six days.[/p][p]The calendar displays special events and NPC birthdays.[/p][p]You can also add your own notes to specific days.[/p][p][/p][p]  [/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]✔ Lastly[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Today we’ve shared some UI elements that have already been implemented in the game.[/p][p]We’ll continue to show more completed UI features as they are ready. Please stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Also, Astra Village is now live on [b]Steam[/b] and [b]Discord[/b]! 
We’d be thrilled if you could [b]add it to your wishlist[/b] and [b]follow[/b] us. 
The [b]Demo version is also available[/b], so please give it a try! ❣[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]➡️ [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294800"]Astra Village Steam Store Link[/url]
➡️ [url="https://discord.gg/XQuZUTCssa"]Astra Village Discord Link[/url][/p]

notes.title: 🎮「Astra Village」Development News #14
notes.content:
[h1][b]
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/eaf15b69dcf85bf184223b2be45fedccac420c4f.png"][/img][/b][/h1][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Hello everyone! This is the Astra Village development team. 👩‍🌾✨[/b] [/p][p align="start"]Today, we'd like to share another round of new UI concept updates![/p][p]
[/p][quote][p]Please note that the content shown here is still in development and may differ from the final release.[/p][/quote][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Profile[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/e7c5610bd39ccb1c0a4b64ae4c0911f3913dc504.png"][/img][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/3d997bdb7d2b8b288856c3c4d348c7f50f8ebfa7.png"][/img]
[/p][p]This section displays the basic character information such as inventory and stats.
Equipment and proficiency can also be viewed on the same screen.[/p][p][/p][p]Since some stats improve based on proficiency, this UI helps players focus on the abilities they wish to enhance.[/p][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Calendar[/h3][p][/p][p align="start"][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/27d48e704dd7a11c574eaf1b59c138d9c10f54b0.png"][/img]
[/p][p]You can check the passage of time by days.
In addition to tracking seasons, the calendar will show special days like festivals and anniversaries.[/p][p][/p][p]It’s a good idea to plan ahead by checking the upcoming schedule.[/p][p]

[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Lastly...[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]We are currently in the implementation phase.
It may take some time for all features to be fully functional, so we plan to showcase them as they become ready.
Please look forward to it![/p][p][/p][p]Also, Astra Village is now live on [b]Steam[/b] and [b]Discord[/b]!
We’d be thrilled if you could [b]add it to your wishlist[/b] and [b]follow[/b] us.
The [b]Demo version is also available[/b], so please give it a try! ❣[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]➡️ [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294800"]Astra Village Steam Store Link[/url]
➡️ [url="https://discord.gg/XQuZUTCssa"]Astra Village Discord Link[/url][/p]

notes.title: 🎮「Astra Village」Development News #13
notes.content:
[h1][b]
[/b][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/eaf15b69dcf85bf184223b2be45fedccac420c4f.png"][/img][/h1][p][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Hello everyone! This is the Astra Village development team. 👩‍🌾✨[/b]
Today, we'd like to share another round of new UI concept updates![/p][p][/p][quote][p]Please note that the content shown here is still in development and may differ from the final release.[/p][/quote][p]

[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Detailed Information in the Ecology Encyclopedia[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/cd12c9d42fe91db7e6c9a4fe128ce935e122b54b.jpg"][/img][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/39cf326ad9776a321ccc1f6ca40455938d3d49ac.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]You can use the arrow buttons below to browse detailed information.[/p][p][/p][p]This includes seasonal availability, appearance times, and details on whether it can be defeated or captured. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Quest Section[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/36c525ac01e4adcd028e7a4c396e829b7fdcce1c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This new section lets you view all quests in one place — from active to completed.
By selecting a quest from the list, you can view more detailed info.[/p][p][/p][p]You'll see details like acceptance date and rewards.
It also includes a sort function to help you easily track quest progress![/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Lastly...[/h3][p][/p][p align="start"]Now that the UI concepts are finalized, we’ll begin implementation.
Once we have something working in-game, we’ll share an update again![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Astra Village is available on Steam and Discord![/b]
We’d love it if you could wishlist and follow us.
The demo version is also available — please give it a try! ❣[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]➡️ [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294800?snr=2___"]Astra Village Steam Store Link[/url][/p][p]➡️ [url="https://discord.gg/XQuZUTCssa"]Astra Village Discord Link[/url][/p]

notes.title: 🎮「Astra Village」Development News #12
notes.content:
[p]
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/eaf15b69dcf85bf184223b2be45fedccac420c4f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello everyone! This is the Astra Village dev team. 👩‍🌾✨
This time, we’d like to share some concept previews of the new UI.[/p][p][/p][p]Please note that the content is still under development and may change upon release.[/p][p]

[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Encyclopedia
[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/3c1ace9a7b068e56d0322b2e186cc56ad8d9af8c.png"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]We’ve gone for an overall pixel-art style.[/p][p]We believe it’s easier to understand and more user-friendly than the previous UI.[/p][p]Rather than relying on text, we’re aiming to convey information through icons and illustrations.[/p][p]

[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Ecology Encyclopedia[/h3][p][/p][p align="start"][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/dbd546418b30838baffa7371d4d023030eea721c.png"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][p]This is a specific type of encyclopedia focused on ecology.[/p][p]It contains monsters, their behaviors, and achievement missions.[/p][p]Detailed information such as capture/defeat counts, sizes, appearance times, and seasons are also displayed.[/p][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Villagers[/h3][p][/p][p align="start"][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/d83aeb30863ed87c963e7c1a0260870640fa8c4f.png"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve also added a page dedicated to villagers.[/p][p]You’ll be able to check their favorite items, currently equipped gear, and affection levels.[/p][p]Since affection will be important in the game, you’ll likely be checking this often.[/p][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ That’s All for Now[/h3][p][/p][p align="start"]There’s still more to come, but for now we’re showcasing parts that are less likely to change.[/p][p]We’ll move forward by implementing features that have already been decided on.[/p][p]
[/p][p align="start"]“Astra Village” is available now on STEAM and Discord![/p][p]We’d be happy if you add it to your wishlist and follow us.[/p][p]A demo version is also live—please give it a try❣[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]➡️ [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294800"]Astra Village Steam Store Link[/url]
➡️ [url="https://discord.gg/XQuZUTCssa"]Astra Village Discord Link[/url][/p]

notes.title: 🎮「Astra Village」Development News #11
notes.content:
[p] [img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/eaf15b69dcf85bf184223b2be45fedccac420c4f.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone! This is the Astra Village development team. 👩‍🌾✨[/p][p]This time, we’ll be continuing with content related to collection.[/p][p][/p][p]※ Please note: Since the game is still in development, the contents may differ from the final release.[/p][p][/p][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Encyclopedia Improvements[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/2668e2133f2c5ca6af353426ef0971abc68902f3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/5055b118f79eee42e65d770468c0354ef8027343.png"][/img][/p][p]As this is still in production, many placeholders are being used.
This is the improvement of the item encyclopedia.[/p][p]A scrollable list has been implemented, divided by categories.
Additionally, there are search functions and related items displayed, allowing you to jump directly and look things up quickly.
[/p][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][h3]
✔ Added Movement for Dropped Fish[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/8150afd3fc38fc6aee7182686929df87c6eb0132.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Unlike regular items, fish start moving once dropped.
They basically just hop around in place, but they can also move a little.[/p][p]There’s no deep meaning behind it.
Isn’t it cute? Yes, it’s cute. That’s right, it’s cute.[/p][p][/p][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][h3]
✔ Astra Village is Available on Steam and Discord[/h3][p][/p][p]We’d be so happy if you could add us to your wishlist and follow us! A demo version is also available — please give it a try! ❣[/p][p][/p][p]➡️ [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294800?snr=2___"]Astra Village Steam Store Link[/url][/p][p]➡️ [url="https://discord.gg/XQuZUTCssa"]Astra Village Discord Link[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🎮「Astra Village」Development News #10
notes.content:
[p]
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/eaf15b69dcf85bf184223b2be45fedccac420c4f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello everyone! This is the Astra Village development team. 👩‍🌾✨[/p][p]This time, we’ll be continuing with content related to collection.[/p][p][/p][p]※ Please note: Since the game is still in development, the contents may differ from the final release.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Camera Function[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/d2dad41f3f96b86fa937cb0871f54651a868deed.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You can now identify objects within the frame and display their names.[/p][p]This includes NPCs, monsters, and corrupted items.[/p][p]Photos you take will be saved as items, which you can view anytime.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Fish & Insect Collection Poses[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/4f51af604e845023058209eab220cbb51977b88e.png"][/img][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/851ba7a4e41ad4ea57fe3fe8089458a37391287e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]When catching fish or insects, your character will now strike a pose.[/p][p]There are emotional expressions like joy, sadness, and neutral.[/p][p]The pose changes depending on what you’ve caught.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Astra Village is Available on Steam and Discord[/h3][p][/p][p]We’d be so happy if you could add us to your wishlist and follow us!
A demo version is also available — please give it a try! ❣[/p][p][/p][p]➡️ [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294800?snr=2___"]Astra Village Steam Store Link[/url][/p][p]➡️ [url="https://discord.gg/XQuZUTCssa"]Astra Village Discord Link[/url][/p]

notes.title: 🎮「Astra Village」Development News #9
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/eaf15b69dcf85bf184223b2be45fedccac420c4f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello everyone! This is the Astra Village development team. 👩‍🌾✨[/p][p]This time, we’re continuing from the collection-based content introduced last time.[/p][p][/p][p]Since the content is still under development, please note that it may differ from the final version upon release.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Camera Function[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/c7a2891270c76a7fab1d1c45fd074790a1882734.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Photos of monsters taken with the camera are now displayed in the encyclopedia.
You can zoom in and out using the mouse wheel.
The monsters in your photos will be automatically identified and recorded in the encyclopedia.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Fishing Function[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/e758036564098866e45d3a23f0f64aa61dd7d118.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/212f91ed9df103c38af65c3962e5f5ad9ef15672.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You can now catch various kinds of fish while fishing.
The available fish will vary depending on the region.
If you find a body of water, try casting a fishing line—it might be fun![/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Insect Catching Function[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/e796c11c702b253d9bf142e45f2fb493a2033a3d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Just like last time, you can approach bugs and catch them using the insect catcher!
It’s really simple![/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]We’re still in the rough development phase, and the direction isn’t completely finalized yet,
but we’re aiming to make completing the encyclopedia as fun as possible.
We look forward to sharing more with you next time![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Currently, "Astra Village" is available on [b]STEAM[/b] and [b]Discord[/b].
We’d be delighted if you could [b]add it to your wishlist[/b] and [b]follow us[/b]!
The [b]demo version is also available[/b], so please give it a try! ❣[/p][p][/p][p]➡️ \[[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294800"]Astra Village Steam Store Link[/url]]
➡️ \[[url="https://discord.gg/XQuZUTCssa"]Astra Village Discord Link[/url]][/p]

notes.title: 🎮「Astra Village」Development News #8
notes.content:
[p]
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/eaf15b69dcf85bf184223b2be45fedccac420c4f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello everyone! This is the Astra Village development team. 👩‍🌾✨ This time we will introduce the addition of features related to collective content.[/p][p]As the content is under development, the content may differ from the content at the time of publication. Please keep that in mind.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Camera Function[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/c47d89972cd563f007f5cd06e53290c1a3c390bf.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The camera function will be implemented as a feature related to the encyclopedia.[/p][p]When you use the camera, it moves following the cursor, and you press a button to photograph monsters.[/p][p]Monsters captured in photos will be recorded in your encyclopedia.[/p][p][/p][p]We plan to automatically identify and register monsters that are inside the frame.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Fishing Function[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/a7fa16be0f453727689120ba17e7761a8eadaf95.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Fishing will be implemented. If you use a fishing rod near water, you will be able to catch fish. Since many people don't want mini-games in fishing, we aim to minimize unnecessary tasks and keep it simple.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Insect Removal Function[/h3][p][/p][h3][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/1a17b290213546fa74a34de3e5f6186bb0f62552.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][p]Insect catching will be implemented. Approach bugs and catch them with a net! Insects found in various locations will also be recorded in your encyclopedia.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Items Have Suddenly Increased[/h3][p]As we’re building a full-fledged encyclopedia system, the amount of items has drastically increased.[/p][p][/p][p]Monsters, insects, fish, food recipes, crafting materials... Everything needs content and resources. So it will take some time to complete.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re working hard so that everyone can play as soon as possible—thank you for your support![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]📢 [b]Astra Village is available on Steam and Discord![/b] The demo version is out now—please give it a try! We’d love your support via [b]wishlisting and following[/b] us.[/p][p][/p][p]➡️ [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294800"]Astra Village Steam Store Link[/url][/p][p]➡️ [url="https://discord.gg/XQuZUTCssa"]Astra Village Discord Link[/url][/p]

notes.title: 🎮「Astra Village」Development News #7
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/eaf15b69dcf85bf184223b2be45fedccac420c4f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Hello everyone! This is the Astra Village dev team. 👩‍🌾✨[/b][/p][p]
Today, we’d like to share some updates mainly focused on [b]enhancements[/b] and new systems![/p][p][/p][p]As always, please note that the game is still under active development, and the final release may differ from what’s shown here. Thanks for your understanding![/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Accessory Equipment Added[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/673fd4bd18e46deaee95adf1eabd28ba8198c3f9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Accessory slots that have long been empty now support new equipment!
These accessories boost stats like HP and attack power—and in some cases, grant special effects as well.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Equipment Synthesis System[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/78f32100600fb56a44927b06d0a189816235313a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A new enhancement feature has been added where you can combine items with your equipment.
There are [b]no fixed recipes[/b], and you can decide how many materials to use.[/p][p]For example, combining a potato with an axe will give you a [b]Potato Axe[/b].
Think strawberry + sword = [b]Strawberry Sword[/b]!
Create your very own unique equipment using your favorite materials.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Dungeon System[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/580964db449cf4f6dbe7821ce49ba53f03457774.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/ff1519b378fbd05e8b58cd578e7025c7c1fa59cc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/cc9fce3c179634d716d15d2989dd630b21d74d55.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/05aa1b5866ba13555e327dd0e6160518b3700c88.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]We’re currently working on a brand-new dungeon system.
It features [b]randomly generated maps[/b] that you explore and conquer while powering up.[/p][p]The design of the map changes drastically every few floors, and various monsters will challenge your strength.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][p]📢 [b]Astra Village is available on Steam and Discord![/b]
The demo version is out now—please give it a try!
We’d love your support via [b]wishlisting and following[/b] us.[/p][p][/p][p]➡️ [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294800"]Astra Village Steam Store Link[/url]
➡️ [url="https://discord.gg/XQuZUTCssa"]Astra Village Discord Link[/url][/p]

notes.title: 🎮「Astra Village」Development News #6
notes.content:
[p]
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/eaf15b69dcf85bf184223b2be45fedccac420c4f.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone! This is the [b]Astra Village[/b] development team. 👩‍🌾✨[/p][p][/p][p]Today, we’re excited to introduce a [b]new map[/b] and [b]new monsters[/b] that will be added to the game![/p][p]Please note that these features are still in development, so the content may change upon release. [/p][p]Thank you for your understanding.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]✔ A New Map Appears[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/c8b0d9edeeb4eac1e3c1c6173f0af94d55847e0b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A dreamy new map that looks like clouds is coming![/p][p][/p][p]The ground feels soft and fluffy, and space stretches out in the background.[/p][p]Everything looks surreal and magical, creating an extraordinary atmosphere.[/p][p]What kinds of stories and encounters await in such a world?[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ New Monsters[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/4e03d9dfbea1b509d3cae8e292d5a4456fda0c00.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Three new monsters will appear in this new map.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/9670cd93de4794a13d6ef1831c9aa4523c2b87f8.gif"][/img][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/00e3f155118d82884d842a65fdd61188a5fc24fb.gif"][/img][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/16ddc3e2c75b991f07c301214f40b676ba7c7d60.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Each has a unique ecology and is rarely found outside the cloud map.[/p][p]Their default animations are quite cute![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ And... A New Feature?[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/67332b4e6863da6900bea717b29a8ef2bc7d03de.png"][/img][/p][p]What is this...?[/p][p][/p][p]Countless monsters,[/p][p]overflowing loot,[/p][p]and glowing orbs circling around.[/p][p]What on earth is happening...?[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][p]In the next update, we’ll introduce this mysterious [b]new content[/b] currently in development.[/p][p]Please look forward to it![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]➡️ [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294800?snr=2___"]\[Astra Village Steam Store Link][/url][/p][p]➡️ \[[url="https://discord.com/invite/XQuZUTCssa"]Astra Village Discord Link][/url][/p][p]➡️ [url="https://ci-en.net/creator/29350"]\[Astra Village Ci-en Link][/url][/p]

notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/eaf15b69dcf85bf184223b2be45fedccac420c4f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello everyone! This is the Astra Village development team. 👩‍🌾✨[/p][p][/p][p]This is our first development news update since the demo release. We're excited to share new features and additional content from our main story updates.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]✔ UI and Hotkey Window Revamp[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/50cee46a3ad2b1f40f305af7bd3e6a83a6cb9648.png"][/img][/p][p]We've made some adjustments to the UI, including the hotkey window. The hotkey window now displays your inventory. When you press [b]Ctrl[/b], the rows above and below the currently displayed line will become semi-transparent, allowing you to scroll with your mouse wheel to move to your desired row.[/p][p][/p][p]We received a lot of feedback that the tooltip window, which appeared at the mouse cursor's position, was inconvenient as it often obscured items. To address this, we've [b]fixed the tooltip window to the bottom right corner[/b] of the screen. To further enhance user convenience, we plan to add explanations to the tooltips when you hover over various interaction buttons.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h3]✔ Chapter 1 Story Update[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/4ef5ad1d26e961dfd42376cac2e4ed3f0100742a.png"][/img][/p][p]We've updated Chapter 1 to address previous shortcomings. We've focused on improving player convenience by modifying quest flows, making event slimes into monsters, changing how recipes are used, and updating cutscenes.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h3]✔ Recipe Usage Change[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/f48560324e178125a5efa7550b12c717d3a4592c.png"][/img][/p][p]One of the most frequent feedback points was about recipe usage, and we've changed it! Previously, there was a lack of explanation on how to use recipes from the item window, and it was difficult to confirm if you possessed a recipe.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, [b]when you enter the crafting screen while possessing a recipe, you can learn it directly from that window[/b]. We believe this will resolve issues where players couldn't find recipes in their inventory or struggled to progress due to not understanding how to use them.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]We'll be back with even more exciting development updates next time! Please also check out our related information, SNS, and Discord communities.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]➡️ [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294800"]\[Astra Village Steam Store Link][/url] [/p][p]➡️ \[[url="https://discord.com/invite/XQuZUTCssa"]Astra Village Discord Link][/url][/p][p]➡️ [url="https://ci-en.net/creator/29350"]\[Astra Village Ci-en Link][/url][/p]

notes.title: 🎮「Astra Village」Development News #3
notes.content:
[h3]✔ We participated in PlayX4[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/d82aabd1b25fc3d10beb17e34a50dd2d352a1b6c.png[/img]

Thank you once again for checking out our game.
We took part in the game exhibition "PlayX4," which was held over four days from May 22 to 25.
The event reportedly drew around 115,000 visitors.

At the venue, we had gamers actually try the game and gathered valuable feedback.
The demo version to be uploaded on Steam will likely be an improved version based on that feedback.



[h3]✔ Controls Guide[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/a6bb6013bc89a5bfae02e7ad2942acfba9ea024d.png[/img]
One of the most common issues we observed was the lack of clear instructions on how to play.
Although various features were available, many players were unaware of them and experienced inconvenience.
Improving this is essential.





[h3]✔ Improved Guidance[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/fb70c9ecff002ea05b2c58d54ba92a0a0cd2166e.png[/img]
After the tutorial, many players didn’t know where to go next.
Originally, we intended for players to talk to an NPC to progress the quest, but the NPC didn’t stand out enough.
Even when nearby, players often passed by without speaking to them.
We think it would be good to add more events to help guide progress.





[h3]✔ More Reward Variety[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/61047f5855c492ff56329eeceb203a4a04fce30f.png[/img]
Since the current ending involves defeating a boss, players tended to focus heavily on recovery items.
In the upcoming improvements, we plan to diversify rewards by adding weapons and farming-related items.





We believe that after making these three major improvements, the demo will be ready for release.
Once the schedule is decided, we’ll announce it on the Steam community and on X (formerly Twitter).

notes.title: 🎉Welcome to Astra Village!
notes.content:
Hello! We are the development team of Astra Village. 👩‍🌾✨

Astra Village is a game that tells the story of a cheerful young girl named Chloe as she works to revive a ruined village and inn.
Enjoy a relaxing farming life, connect with the villagers, and embark on exciting adventures in a vibrant world.

We are currently aiming for a release within this year, and we look forward to sharing more news with you soon!

In this community, we will:
- Share development updates
- Reveal new screenshots and videos
- Gather feedback from players

We sincerely appreciate your warm support and anticipation!
And if you haven't added us to your wishlist yet, please do so! 🎁
